import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxN = 50;
    static final int maxM = 50;
    static final int maxK = 50;
    static final int T_val = maxN + maxK + 1;
    static final int maxN_nodes = maxN * T_val + 1;
    static final int maxM_edges = maxK + (maxM * 2 * maxK + maxN) * (T_val - 1);
    static final int INF_DIST = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class AdjacencyNode {
        AdjacencyNode next_ptr;
        int target_node;
    }

    static AdjacencyNode[] node_array = new AdjacencyNode[maxN];
    static AdjacencyNode[] node_array2 = new AdjacencyNode[maxN_nodes];
    static AdjacencyNode[] buffer_pool_1 = null;
    static AdjacencyNode[] buffer_pool_2 = null;

    static int[] potential_arr = new int[maxN_nodes];
    static int[] layer_dist = new int[maxN_nodes];
    static int[] parent_edge = new int[maxN_nodes];
    static int[] heap_arr = new int[maxN_nodes + 2];
    static int[] heap_pos = new int[maxN_nodes];
    static int heap_elem_count;

    static boolean heap_lessthan(int node_a, int node_b) {
        return potential_arr[node_a] < potential_arr[node_b] || 
            (potential_arr[node_a] == potential_arr[node_b] && layer_dist[node_a] < layer_dist[node_b]);
    }

    static int heap_getchild(int index) {
        index *= 2;
        if (index > heap_elem_count) return 0;
        if (index < heap_elem_count && heap_lessthan(heap_arr[index+1], heap_arr[index])) return index+1;
        return index;
    }

    static void heap_moveup(int node_val) {
        int idx = heap_pos[node_val];
        int parent_idx;
        while ((parent_idx = idx / 2) != 0 && heap_lessthan(node_val, heap_arr[parent_idx])) {
            heap_arr[heap_pos[heap_arr[parent_idx]] = idx] = heap_arr[parent_idx];
            idx = parent_idx;
        }
        heap_arr[heap_pos[node_val] = idx] = node_val;
    }

    static void heap_movedown(int node_val) {
        int idx = heap_pos[node_val];
        int child_idx;
        while ((child_idx = heap_getchild(idx)) != 0 && heap_lessthan(heap_arr[child_idx], node_val)) {
            heap_arr[heap_pos[heap_arr[child_idx]] = idx] = heap_arr[child_idx];
            idx = child_idx;
        }
        heap_arr[heap_pos[node_val] = idx] = node_val;
    }

    static void heap_enqueue(int node_val) {
        heap_pos[node_val] = ++heap_elem_count;
        heap_moveup(node_val);
    }

    static int heap_dequeue() {
        int result = heap_arr[1];
        int last_node = heap_arr[heap_elem_count--];
        heap_pos[last_node] = 1;
        heap_movedown(last_node);
        return result;
    }

    static void extend_adjacency(int source_node, int dest_node) {
        if (buffer_pool_1 == null) {
            buffer_pool_1 = new AdjacencyNode[maxM * 2 + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < buffer_pool_1.length; i++) {
                buffer_pool_1[i] = new AdjacencyNode();
            }
            buffer_pool_1--;
        }
        buffer_pool_1[0].target_node = dest_node;
        buffer_pool_1[0].next_ptr = node_array[source_node].next_ptr;
        node_array[source_node].next_ptr = buffer_pool_1[0];
        buffer_pool_1++;
    }

    static void extend_secondary_graph(int vertex, int edge_index) {
        if (buffer_pool_2 == null) {
            buffer_pool_2 = new AdjacencyNode[maxM_edges * 2 + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < buffer_pool_2.length; i++) {
                buffer_pool_2[i] = new AdjacencyNode();
            }
            buffer_pool_2--;
        }
        buffer_pool_2[0].target_node = edge_index;
        buffer_pool_2[0].next_ptr = node_array2[vertex].next_ptr;
        node_array2[vertex].next_ptr = buffer_pool_2[0];
        buffer_pool_2++;
    }

    static int node_count, edge_count;
    static int[] edge_from = new int[maxM_edges];
    static int[] edge_to = new int[maxM_edges];
    static int[] edge_xor = new int[maxM_edges];
    static int[] edge_cost = new int[maxM_edges];
    static int[] edge_cost_reduced = new int[maxM_edges];
    static int[] edge_capacity = new int[maxM_edges * 2];

    static void add_edge(int node_u, int node_v, int capacity_val, int cost_val) {
        int idx = edge_count++;
        edge_from[idx] = node_u;
        edge_to[idx] = node_v;
        edge_xor[idx] = node_u ^ node_v;
        edge_cost[idx] = cost_val;
        edge_capacity[idx * 2] = capacity_val;
        extend_secondary_graph(node_u, idx * 2);
        extend_secondary_graph(node_v, idx * 2 + 1);
    }

    static void dijkstra_shortestpath(int source_vertex) {
        Arrays.fill(potential_arr, INF_DIST);
        potential_arr[source_vertex] = 0;
        heap_enqueue(source_vertex);
        while (heap_elem_count > 0) {
            AdjacencyNode iter;
            int curr_node = heap_dequeue();
            int neighbor_node;
            int edge_idx, edge_idx_temp;
            int cost_estimate;
            int new_layer = layer_dist[curr_node] + 1;

            for (iter = node_array2[curr_node].next_ptr; iter != null; iter = iter.next_ptr) {
                edge_idx_temp = iter.target_node;
                if (edge_capacity[edge_idx_temp] > 0) {
                    edge_idx = edge_idx_temp >> 1;
                    cost_estimate = potential_arr[curr_node] + ((edge_idx_temp & 1) == 0 ? 
                        edge_cost_reduced[edge_idx] : -edge_cost_reduced[edge_idx]);
                    neighbor_node = curr_node ^ edge_xor[edge_idx];
                    if (potential_arr[neighbor_node] == INF_DIST) {
                        potential_arr[neighbor_node] = cost_estimate;
                        layer_dist[neighbor_node] = new_layer;
                        parent_edge[neighbor_node] = edge_idx_temp;
                        heap_enqueue(neighbor_node);
                    } else if (potential_arr[neighbor_node] > cost_estimate || 
                        (potential_arr[neighbor_node] == cost_estimate && layer_dist[neighbor_node] > new_layer)) {
                        potential_arr[neighbor_node] = cost_estimate;
                        layer_dist[neighbor_node] = new_layer;
                        parent_edge[neighbor_node] = edge_idx_temp;
                        heap_moveup(neighbor_node);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void augment_flow(int source_node, int sink_node) {
        int curr, idx, idx_temp;
        for (curr = sink_node; curr != source_node; curr ^= edge_xor[idx]) {
            idx = (idx_temp = parent_edge[curr]) >> 1;
            edge_capacity[idx_temp]--;
            edge_capacity[idx_temp ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    static int min_cost_maxflow(int source_vertex, int sink_vertex) {
        int total_flow_cost = 0, idx;
        System.arraycopy(edge_cost, 0, edge_cost_reduced, 0, edge_count);
        while (true) {
            dijkstra_shortestpath(source_vertex);
            if (potential_arr[sink_vertex] == INF_DIST) break;
            augment_flow(source_vertex, sink_vertex);
            for (idx = 0; idx < edge_count; idx++) {
                int u = edge_from[idx];
                int v = edge_to[idx];
                if (potential_arr[u] != INF_DIST && potential_arr[v] != INF_DIST)
                    edge_cost_reduced[idx] += potential_arr[u] - potential_arr[v];
            }
        }
        total_flow_cost = 0;
        for (idx = 0; idx < edge_count; idx++)
            total_flow_cost += edge_cost[idx] * edge_capacity[idx * 2 + 1];
        return total_flow_cost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] start_nodes = new int[maxK];
        int n, m, k, c, d, t, h, i, j, s, u, v, x;
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        k = scanner.nextInt();
        c = scanner.nextInt();
        d = scanner.nextInt();
        for (h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            start_nodes[h] = scanner.nextInt();
            start_nodes[h]--;
        }
        while (m-- > 0) {
            i = scanner.nextInt();
            j = scanner.nextInt();
            i--; j--;
            extend_adjacency(i, j);
            extend_adjacency(j, i);
        }
        t = n + k + 1;
        node_count = n * t + 1;
        edge_count = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                AdjacencyNode iter;
                u = i * t + s;
                for (iter = node_array[i].next_ptr; iter != null; iter = iter.next_ptr) {
                    j = iter.target_node;
                    v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (x = 1; x <= k; x++)
                        add_edge(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                u = i * t + s;
                v = u + 1;
                add_edge(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        for (h = 0; h < k; h++)
            add_edge(node_count - 1, start_nodes[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        System.out.println(min_cost_maxflow(node_count - 1, 0 * t + t - 1));
    }
}
